title: Structural insights on the effects of mutation of a charged binding pocket residue on phosphopeptide binding to 14-3-3 ζ Protein
authors: T S Sreevidya; Somavally Dalvi; Prasanna Venkataraman; Satyavani Vemparala
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟研究14-3-3ζ蛋白结合口袋残基突变对磷酸化肽段结合的影响，属于广义蛋白-肽互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作机制研究。
abstract: Mutation of an invariant aspartate residue in the binding pocket of 14-3-3 ζ isoform to alanine dramatically reduced phosphopeptide binding and induced opening of the binding pocket. Here we use extensive molecular dynamics simulations to understand the role of D124 residue in ligand binding. The simulations show that in the absence of phosphopeptide, the D124A mutation leads to binding pocket reorganization including widening up of the binding pocket at the major groove and repositioning of N173, a key residue that interacts with the main chain of phosphopeptide. These structural changes would interfere with the efficient binding of the peptide, corroborating the experimental observations. Both gain and loss of electrostatic interactions in the form of salt bridges strongly indicate a rearrangement of the network of interactions within the binding pocket. Limited proteolysis coupled mass spectrometry (lip-MS) of the apo and holo forms of WT and mutant protein shows a peptide binding helix otherwise buried in the WT protein was particularly accessible to trypsin in the apo form of the mutant protein and the region was mapped to 158-186 amino acid residues of 14-3-3 ζ ). These results further confirm the dynamic nature of D124A mutant. Unlike other basic residues, the invariant D124 facilitates peptide binding by maintaining the geometry of interacting residues and by enforcing the structural integrity of amphipathic pocket.
abstract_zh: 14-3-3 ζ 亚型结合口袋中一个不变的天冬氨酸残基突变为丙氨酸，显著降低了磷酸肽结合能力，并诱导结合口袋的开放。本文利用广泛的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟来理解 D124 残基在配体结合中的作用。模拟显示，在无磷酸肽存在的情况下，D124A 突变导致结合口袋重组，包括主沟处结合口袋的加宽以及 N173（一个与磷酸肽主链相互作用的关键残基）的重定位。这些结构变化会干扰肽的有效结合，与实验观察结果相印证。盐桥形式的静电相互作用的获得和丧失均强烈表明结合口袋内相互作用网络发生了重排。对 WT 和突变蛋白的 apo 和 holo 形式进行的有限蛋白水解偶联质谱 (limited proteolysis coupled mass spectrometry, lip-MS) 显示，一个在 WT 蛋白中原本埋藏的肽结合螺旋在突变蛋白的 apo 形式中对胰蛋白酶特别可及，该区域被定位到 14-3-3 ζ 的第 158-186 个氨基酸残基。这些结果进一步证实了 D124A 突变体的动态特性。与其他碱性残基不同，不变的 D124 通过维持相互作用残基的几何构型并强化两亲性口袋的结构完整性来促进肽结合。
